bib.title: Flickr30k Entities: Collecting Region-to-Phrase Correspondences for Richer Image-to-Sentence Models
bib.venue: preprint (arXiv v4, 19 Sep 2016; journal version 'Noname manuscript'; preliminary version ICCV 2015)

read.skipped: Reference list skimmed only (ends the text); no appendices exist.

question: Can dense region-to-phrase ground truth for image captions be collected at scale, and how well can current methods localize textual entity mentions and use that to improve image-sentence retrieval?
hypothesis: Grounding language to image regions is hard and fundamental enough to need its own annotations and benchmark; better phrase localization is expected, but not guaranteed, to help global image-sentence tasks.
contributions: Flickr30k Entities: 244k coreference chains and 276k manually annotated boxes over the 158k Flickr30k captions
A phrase localization benchmark (Recall@K at IoU >= 0.5)
A strong CCA + detector + size + color baseline
An analysis showing phrase localization gains do not easily transfer to image-sentence retrieval

method.summary: Crowdsourced (AMT) pipeline of atomic tasks links NP mentions across the 5 captions of each Flickr30k image into coreference chains and draws boxes per chain. A CCA region-phrase embedding (word2vec/HGLMM Fisher vectors and VGG19 or Fast RCNN features) is combined with PASCAL detector scores, a size prior and a color classifier to localize phrases among 200 EdgeBox proposals; the same model is added to a whole-image CCA for retrieval.
method.task: phrase localization (grounding) benchmark and bidirectional image-sentence retrieval

datasets.name: Flickr30k Entities
datasets.size: 31,783 images; 158,915 captions; 513,644 mentions; 244,035 coreference chains; 275,775 boxes
datasets.split: 29,783 train / 1,000 val / 1,000 test images (same split as Gong et al. 2014b)
datasets.source: Flickr30k (Young et al. 2014) captions with new AMT annotations
datasets.preprocessing: NP chunks from Flickr30k chunking (avg 2.35 words); personal pronouns and non-visual terms excluded; boxes merged at IoU >= 0.8 (0.9 for other), cutting boxes 19.8% and chains 5.9%

datasets.name: PASCAL VOC 2007+2012 trainval
datasets.source: used to fine-tune Fast RCNN detector

models.name: CCA region-phrase embedding
models.architecture: Canonical Correlation Analysis, linear projections to 4096-D; phrase = 300-D word2vec, Fisher Vector HGLMM with 30 centers = 18,000-D; region = 4096-D fc activations of VGG19 (ImageNet) or Fast RCNN VGG19 (PASCAL fine-tuned)

models.name: Fast RCNN color classifier
models.architecture: Fast RCNN fine-tuned for 11 colors, softmax loss, people phrases excluded

training.objective: CCA (maximise correlation of image and text views); color net: softmax classification over 11 colors
training.optimizer: color net: SGD with momentum 0.9 (inferred from lr/momentum listing)
training.regularisation: at most N=10 random region exemplars per phrase for CCA training

other.size_weight_w_size: 0.2 for scene, vehicle, instrument; 0.1 for all else, set on validation
other.detector_mapping: manual map of phrases to 20 PASCAL categories, covers 25.32% of phrases (83.4% of those person)

inference.decoding: rank 200 EdgeBox proposals per phrase by combined distance; NMS IoU 0.5
inference.samples: single run; no seeds or variance reported
inference.retrieval: retrieval: D_SI = alpha*D_CCA + (1-alpha)*D_PR, alpha = 0.7, gamma = 1.5; ground-truth NP chunks used as phrases

other.multi-box_phrases: regions merged into a single bounding box for CCA training

metrics.name: Recall@K (phrase localization)
metrics.definition: percentage of phrase queries for which a correct proposal (IoU >= 0.5 with ground truth box) has rank <= K, K=1,5,10

metrics.name: Recall@K (image-sentence retrieval)
metrics.definition: percentage of queries for which at least one correct ground truth match is in top K; 1,000 test images, 5,000 sentences

metrics.name: Matched gold links / chains, FP/FN rate
metrics.definition: annotation-strategy agreement with gold on 200 images

eval.protocol: Test with ground-truth NP chunks; automatic chunking lowers recall by about 3%. AP dropped because annotations are sparse (reporting bias). Competing methods use 100 proposals, ours 200.

evidence.quote: we split Flickr30K into 29,783 training, 1,000 validation, and 1,000 test images

results.quote: yielded 275,775 bounding boxes in the 31,783 images

results.table: Table 2, column Greedy Plus, row Matched Gold Links

results.setup: valid regions for body parts and clothing lack boxes when not mentioned in captions

limits: Annotation is sparse: mentioned entities only, so valid unmentioned regions count as wrong and AP is unreliable (authors dropped it).
Phrases are scored without sentence context, so identical mentions land on the same box; no constraint ties people to clothing or body parts.
Multi-box phrases are merged into one box for training and the benchmark.
Proposal recall caps results: only about 50% of body parts and 77% of clothing have a proposal at IoU>=0.5 among 200; more proposals lowered precision.
Gains in localization do not carry to image-sentence retrieval (about 1 point).
Competing results use 100 proposals versus 200 here, and results are single-run without variance.
Evaluation uses ground-truth NP chunks; automatic chunking lowers recall by about 3%.
Data bias: images focus mainly on people and animals; about 8% of images contain some annotation error.
w_color, the manual phrase-to-PASCAL mapping, and code are not released or stated in the text.
